data.text: Out of the depths I cry to you, LORD.
data.titulo: Out of the Depths I Cry to You

data.text: Lord, hear my voice; let your ears be attentive to the voice of my pleas.
If you, LORD, kept account of iniquities, Lord, who could stand?
But with you there is forgiveness, so that you may be feared.
I wait for the LORD; my soul waits, and in his word I hope.
data.titulo: Waiting for the LORD and His Redemption

data.text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.
Israel, hope in the LORD, for with the LORD there is steadfast love, and with him there is abundant redemption.
He himself will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.
